article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community event announcement inviting players to a player-versus-player kart racing session at Frost Ridge Speedway on Friday, August 28, 2009, 11am-1pm Pacific Time, on Server 7. Players join via the Kart Racing Lobby icon, and must create a race with the max players and 'Enable AI' turned off to race only against each other. The page's relative post time ('3 days, 15 hours ago' at capture on 2009-08-31) puts the posting around 2009-08-27, but no exact post date is shown.
